answer: Deposits are visible in bridge, and summit reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 94 aliases, and each one needs its own funded ferrous account. A bond of 41% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 7 epochs. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
